## SpawnableTypeDef

SpawnableTypeDef defines randomized cargo and attachment contents for one item
class.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 7 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### SpawnableTypeDef.name

Key: `name`

Path: [`type`](#spawnabletypesfiletype).`[]`.`name`

Name is the game class whose cargo and attachment spawn rules are defined.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |
| Examples | `Barrel_Blue` |

### SpawnableTypeDef.attachments

Key: `attachments`

Path: [`type`](#spawnabletypesfiletype).`[]`.`attachments`

Attachments defines the items or named preset that can be attached to this item.
Defining attachments in an override replaces the original attachment rules for
this type.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items reference | [`SpawnableAttachment`](#spawnableattachment) (`#/$defs/SpawnableAttachment`) |

### SpawnableTypeDef.cargo

Key: `cargo`

Path: [`type`](#spawnabletypesfiletype).`[]`.`cargo`

Cargo defines the items or named preset that can be generated inside this item's
cargo. Defining cargo in an override replaces the original cargo rules for this
type.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items reference | [`SpawnableCargo`](#spawnablecargo) (`#/$defs/SpawnableCargo`) |

### SpawnableTypeDef.SpawnableMinMax

Key: `damage`

Path: [`type`](#spawnabletypesfiletype).`[]`.`damage`

Damage sets the minimum and maximum health for the spawned item. In an override
file, this setting affects only new or redefined types.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`SpawnableMinMax`](#spawnableminmax) (`#/$defs/SpawnableMinMax`) |

Key: `hoarder`

Path: [`type`](#spawnabletypesfiletype).`[]`.`hoarder`

Hoarder marks this class for hoarder-related spawn handling.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`EmptyElement`](#emptyelement) (`#/$defs/EmptyElement`) |

### SpawnableTypeDef.tag

Key: `tag`

Path: [`type`](#spawnabletypesfiletype).`[]`.`tag`

Tags attach named filters used to select compatible spawn presets.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items reference | [`NamedRef`](#namedref) (`#/$defs/NamedRef`) |

### SpawnableTypeDef.EmptyElement

Key: `unique`

Path: [`type`](#spawnabletypesfiletype).`[]`.`unique`
